name: ferridis
description: Bring Ferridis-connected capabilities — including wrapped MCP servers — to VS Code via native MCP support.

ferridis.serverPath.markdownDescription:
Absolute path to the `ferridis-mcp-server` binary. Build it with:
```
cd rust && cargo build --release -p ferridis-mcp-server
```
Then set this to `rust/target/release/ferridis-mcp-server`.

ferridis.adaptersConfig.markdownDescription: Path to the adapters JSON config file. Defaults to `~/.ferridis/adapters.json` when empty. Each entry is a native Ferridis adapter, an MCP SSE server, or an MCP stdio server — all are discovered and re-exposed as MCP tools.

ferridis.keychainNamespace.description: OS keychain service name used for credential storage.
